scope: All 565 assigned original design/text/layout/navigation concepts in the single-phase pinned coverage expansion.
method: Manually inspected every row of38 native AppKit pages at 1x and 2x: Duotone, Solid and Stroke at 16/24/32 pt in light and dark. Inspected 58 correction rows again after geometry and typography refinements; inspected the five final Boolean/opacity tone rows after alpha clipping. No approval was inferred from rendering or geometry checks alone.
